correctness.rationale: For each odd prime an explicit polynomial-iterate congruence proves the exact least period \(p^{\max(N-1-\nu_p(x^2-a),0)}\). The root fiber count follows from fixed-by-p^t counts, yielding an invertible cycle/root transform. Root classifications by valuation and Legendre symbol give exact parameter type frequencies. The conditional root-lift martingale and the uv=(x-y)(x+y) pair count establish Cov(R_j,R_k)=(p-1)min(j,k)/p, from which each covariance formula follows by finite algebra. Haar square classes yield the heavy-tailed limit and divergence of its second moment. Independent finite checker compared 2606 direct permutations and 14 complete exact ensembles; finite checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The simplest nonlinear one-parameter perturbations of the identity over odd prime-power rings have a natural and complete arithmetic cycle-type histogram across their constant shifts. The sharp negative sign between maximal and every shorter cycle count, versus positive covariance between all remaining distinct sizes, is a structural dependence phenomenon not visible from single-state period formulas or a mean cycle count. The common almost-sure heavy-tailed limit despite linearly divergent variances explains the arithmetic rare-event mechanism and gives a reusable benchmark for more general p-adic dynamical ensembles.
